title: Special Edition: A Guide to the Mueller Hearings

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是纽约时报的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Special counsel Robert Mueller will testify before two House committees tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒明天将在两个众议院委员会面前作证。

sentences.en: Mike Schmidt on what to expect.
sentences.zh: 迈克·施密特为您解读有何看点。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday afternoon, July 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月23日，星期二下午。

sentences.en: I think we could probably, um, we could probably think about opening up the line.
sentences.zh: 我想我们大概可以，呃，我们大概可以考虑接听热线了。

sentences.en: It's open.
sentences.zh: 已经开通了。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我挺好的。

sentences.en: It's been a while.
sentences.zh: 好久不见。

sentences.en: I missed you.
sentences.zh: 我想你了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I gotta figure out how to use this thing.
sentences.zh: 我得研究一下怎么用这玩意儿。

sentences.en: I knew that your response to I miss you would be, not that you missed me.
sentences.zh: 我早就知道你对“我想你”的回应不会是“你也想我”。

sentences.en: You were emotionally avoidant.
sentences.zh: 你在情感上一直在逃避。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 来吧。

sentences.en: This is, The Daily has now become therapy.
sentences.zh: 瞧，《每日新闻》现在变成心理咨询了。

sentences.en: Okay, Mike Schmidt.
sentences.zh: 好了，迈克·施密特。

sentences.en: So we are gathered here today because it's the eve of the Mueller testimony.
sentences.zh: 我们今天聚在这里，是因为明天就是穆勒作证的前夕。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: In many other circumstances, if we were going to hear from the person who was in charge of an investigation, it would be a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 在许多其他情况下，如果我们能听到负责一项调查的人亲自发言，那将是一件大事。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But there are some factors here that have taken a lot of the air out of it.
sentences.zh: 但这里有一些因素消解了许多热度。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: One is Attorney General Bill Barr by announcing initially that the president had not broken the law
sentences.zh: 一个是司法部长比尔·巴尔最初宣布总统没有触犯法律，

sentences.en: and having the report come out many weeks later really made it harder for the Democrats to then take the report and run with it when it came out.
sentences.zh: 而且让报告在数周后才公之于众，这确实让民主党人在报告出炉时很难顺着它大做文章。

sentences.en: The second thing is that Mueller has been told by the Justice Department that he is only to speak about the contents of his report.
sentences.zh: 第二件事是，司法部已经告诉穆勒，他只能谈论其报告的内容。

sentences.en: He has to stay within the four corners of the document.
sentences.zh: 他必须局限于这份文件的四角之内。

sentences.en: He can't get into internal deliberations about his office or discussions about the rationale for the decisions they made.
sentences.zh: 他不能涉足他办公室内部的审议工作，也不能讨论他们做出决策的理由。

sentences.en: Third is that we're so far removed from the release of the report.
sentences.zh: 第三点是，距离报告发布已经过去了很久。

sentences.en: The public has already consumed as much of the report as they're probably going to.
sentences.zh: 公众对这份报告的消化程度已经差不多到头了。

sentences.en: And the Democrats have determined they can only really take this so far and have avoided impeachment proceedings.
sentences.zh: 而且民主党人已经确定他们只能走到这一步，并避免了弹劾程序。

sentences.en: And now it's time to hear from the guy who led the investigation.
sentences.zh: 现在是听取领导调查的那个人发言的时候了。

sentences.en: Wow, you're really building this up, this denouement, anti-climax of yours.
sentences.zh: 哇，你还真是在为你的这个结局、这个反高潮做铺垫啊。

sentences.en: Well, the Democrats have really wanted to hear from Mueller himself.
sentences.zh: 好吧，民主党人确实非常希望能听到穆勒本人的说法。

sentences.en: And it was clear from Mueller's body posture and then the press conference he had in the weeks after the report that he did not want to testify.
sentences.zh: 从穆勒的肢体语言以及报告发布几周后他举行的新闻发布会上，可以明显看出他并不想作证。

sentences.en: When he held the press conference, he said, look, you guys can call me up there, but I'm not going to say anything beyond what I have already said in the report.
sentences.zh: 他在举行新闻发布会时说过，听着，你们可以叫我去，但我不会说任何超出我在报告中已经说过的内容。

sentences.en: So instead of us building here towards a climactic event where the investigator is going to come down
sentences.zh: 所以，我们并没有在这里走向一个高潮事件——调查人员会亲自前来，

sentences.en: and really lay things out, we already probably know many of the facts that will be resuscitated tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 并把事情剖析清楚，相反，对于明天将被重提的许多事实，我们可能已经知晓了。

sentences.en: Is resuscitated the right word?
sentences.zh: “重提”是正确的词吗？

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我觉得对吧。

sentences.en: No, you resuscitate some.
sentences.zh: 不对，你那是“抢救”某个东西。

sentences.en: Revived?
sentences.zh: 唤醒？

sentences.en: Reinforced?
sentences.zh: 强化？

sentences.en: We created?
sentences.zh: 我们创造的？

sentences.en: We already know many of the facts that will be restated tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们已经知道了许多明天将被再次阐述的事实。

sentences.en: The difference here and what Democrats are hoping is that the simple fact of Mueller talking about this publicly resonates differently with the public than the report did.
sentences.zh: 这里的区别以及民主党人所希望的是，穆勒公开谈论这件事这一简单事实，在公众中产生的共鸣与报告本身有所不同。

sentences.en: Someone sitting there talking about the report, does that reach people in a way that the document did not?
sentences.zh: 某个人坐在那里谈论这份报告，这种方式是否能触及人们，而这是文件所做不到的？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And not just someone, Robert Mueller.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅是某个人，是罗伯特·穆勒。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The person who the country has obsessed about for the past two years.
sentences.zh: 过去两年全国上下为之着迷的那个人。

sentences.en: But why has it taken so long to get Mueller up there?
sentences.zh: 但为什么让穆勒出席花了这么长时间？

sentences.en: Why has it been almost exactly four months since Mueller delivered the report to Attorney General Barr that we're finally hearing from him?
sentences.zh: 为什么距离穆勒将报告递交给司法部长巴尔已经过去几乎正好四个月，我们才终于听到他的发言？

sentences.en: I think that Democrats at first were concerned about subpoenaing him and what the optics of that may look like.
sentences.zh: 我想民主党人最初担心的是传唤他，以及这在舆论上看起来会是怎样。

sentences.en: And I think that Mueller had initially said he didn't want to do this.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为穆勒最初表示他不想这么做。

sentences.en: So did Democrats want to look like they were strong arming the investigator up to the Hill to testify
sentences.zh: 所以民主党人会想显得他们在强迫调查人员去国会山作证吗？

sentences.en: when he's been on the record saying, hey, guys, if you call me up there, I'm not going to go beyond my report.
sentences.zh: 而他已经明确表态：嘿，伙计们，如果你们叫我去，我是不会超出我的报告范围的。

sentences.en: So it's probably not worth it.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能不值得。

sentences.en: So this issue sort of languished on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 因此这个问题就这样被无限期地搁置了。

sentences.en: And the Democrats went out and they tried to get other witnesses to come and testify.
sentences.zh: 然后民主党人走出去，试图找其他证人来作证。

sentences.en: And then eventually they decided to subpoena Mueller and Mueller agreed to comply.
sentences.zh: 接着他们最终决定传唤穆勒，而穆勒同意配合。

sentences.en: OK, let's talk about what we're expecting to actually happen on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们来谈谈我们预期周三实际会发生什么。

sentences.en: Given what we know about Mueller's reluctance to testify, given the instructions from the Justice Department
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们了解到的穆勒不愿作证的倾向，鉴于司法部的指示，

sentences.en: and Mueller's own signals that everything he has to say, he has poured into the actual report, what would success look like for the Democrats?
sentences.zh: 以及穆勒自己释放的信号——他要说的一切都已经倾注在实际报告中了，对民主党人来说，怎样的结果才算成功？

sentences.en: In a dream scenario for the Democrats, Mueller would come out and say that if Trump was not the president, he would have been indicted.
sentences.zh: 在民主党人的梦想剧本中，穆勒会站出来说，如果特朗普不是总统，他早就被起诉了。

sentences.en: Now, the chances of that are highly unlikely.
sentences.zh: 现在，这种可能性微乎其微。

sentences.en: But Mueller essentially asserting that the president did break the law would be a potential game changer.
sentences.zh: 但穆勒实质上断言总统确实触犯了法律，这将是一个潜在的局势改变者。

sentences.en: In a more realistic expectation mindset, I would say that Democrats hope that Mueller can animate the report to the point that it resonates differently with the American public.
sentences.zh: 在一个更现实的期望心态下，我想说民主党人希望穆勒能够将报告盘活，使其在产生共鸣时与美国公众产生不同的效果。

sentences.en: Basically kind of voicing the audio book version of his report.
sentences.zh: 基本上就像是为他的报告录制有声书版本一样。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Is the audio book enough to move the public in the direction of impeachment?
sentences.zh: 有声书足以推动公众朝着弹劾的方向发展吗？

sentences.en: Or to a lesser extent, is the audio book enough to politically impact the president with the American public?
sentences.zh: 或者退一步说，有声书足以在政治上对美国公众中的总统产生影响吗？

sentences.en: Does it resonate with voters and help the Democrats build a narrative coming into the 2020 campaign?
sentences.zh: 它能引起选民的共鸣，并帮助民主党人在迎接2020年竞选时构建叙事吗？

sentences.en: So running with this metaphor, give me an example of a chapter that might be powerful to hear read aloud by Mueller from the report during this hearing.
sentences.zh: 顺着这个隐喻，请举个例子，说明听穆勒在这次听证会上大声朗读报告中的哪一章可能会很有力量。

sentences.en: So as an obstructionist, myself, someone who has followed the obstruction story,
sentences.zh: 作为我自己，一个妨碍司法罪的研究者，一个一直追踪妨碍司法故事的人，

sentences.en: I think that hearing Mueller talk about how the president tried to pressure Don McGahn, the White House counsel,
sentences.zh: 我认为听穆勒讲述总统如何试图施压白宫法律顾问唐·麦加恩，

sentences.en: to recant on what he told Mueller's investigators could be potentially powerful because it shows the president trying to tamper with a witness
sentences.zh: 让他收回对穆勒调查人员所说的话，可能会具有潜在的强烈的力量，因为它展示了总统试图干预证人，

sentences.en: and doing something that the average person may understand as obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 并且做了一件普通人可能理解为妨碍司法公正的事情。

sentences.en: I have to say, I'm a little bit distracted.
sentences.zh: 我得说，我有点走神了。

sentences.en: Are there other obstructionists or is this kind of an academic field of one?
sentences.zh: 还有其他妨碍司法研究者吗，还是说这是一个孤立的学术领域？

sentences.en: I always say that my colleague Mark Mazzetti is a collusioniSt.
sentences.zh: 我总是说我的同事马克·马佐蒂是个“通俄论者”。

sentences.en: He spent all of his time on collusion.
sentences.zh: 他把所有的精力都花在了通俄上。

sentences.en: You on obstruction.
sentences.zh: 而你则是妨碍司法。

sentences.en: And I'm an obstructionist, an obstructionist guy.
sentences.zh: 我是个妨碍司法者，一个妨碍司法的人。

sentences.en: I'm not obstructioniSt.
sentences.zh: 我可不是妨碍司法者。

sentences.en: I've not gotten in the way of the investigation, I don't think.
sentences.zh: 我想我并没有妨碍调查。

sentences.en: Right, right.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Legally.
sentences.zh: 从法律上讲。

sentences.en: Ahead of the hearing, some notable figures who are central to the investigation have suggested some lines of questioning that they think the Democrats should follow
sentences.zh: 在听证会之前，一些对调查至关重要的知名人物提出了一些他们认为民主党人应该遵循的质询方向，

sentences.en: in the service of the party's goals in these hearings.
sentences.zh: 以服务于该党在这些听证会上的目标。

sentences.en: Jim Comey, for example, the former head of the FBI, who's firing by the president, was a focus of the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 例如，前联邦调查局局长詹姆士·科米，总统解雇他的举动曾是穆勒调查的焦点。

sentences.en: He published a whole list of questions for the Democrats to ask.
sentences.zh: 他公布了一整串问题供民主党人提问。

sentences.en: I wonder if you could read some of those.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你能否读出其中一些。

sentences.en: Did you find that there were a series of contacts between the Trump campaign and individuals with ties to the Russian government?
sentences.zh: 你们是否发现特朗普竞选团队与同俄罗斯政府有联系的个人之间存在一系列接触？

sentences.en: In particular, did you find that a Trump foreign policy advisor learned that the Russians had dirt on Hillary Clinton in the form of thousands of emails?
sentences.zh: 特别是，你们是否发现特朗普的一位外交政策顾问获悉俄罗斯人掌握了关于希拉里·克林顿的黑料，形式是数千封电子邮件？

sentences.en: Did you find that the Trump foreign policy advisor said that the Trump campaign had received indications from the Russian government
sentences.zh: 你们是否发现这位特朗普的外交政策顾问曾表示，特朗普竞选团队收到来自俄罗斯政府的暗示，

sentences.en: that it could assist the campaign through the anonymous release of information damaging to candidate Clinton?
sentences.zh: 即俄罗斯可以通过匿名发布损害候选人克林顿的信息来协助竞选？

sentences.en: By the way, that's the beSt.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这个最棒。

sentences.en: That's the best one.
sentences.zh: 这是最好的一条。

sentences.en: The first ones are kind of weak.
sentences.zh: 前面的那些有点弱。

sentences.en: Okay, those are questions from volume one of the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 好的，这些是穆勒报告第一卷中的问题。

sentences.en: What about those are collusion questions?
sentences.zh: 那第二卷里关于妨碍司法的问题呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 第二卷。

sentences.en: What about obstructionist questions from volume two?
sentences.zh: 你们是否就总统是否犯有妨碍司法公正罪做出了判断？

sentences.en: Volume two.
sentences.zh: 你们是否发现了总统犯有妨碍司法公正罪的大量证据？

sentences.en: Did you reach a judgment as to whether the president had committed obstruction of justice crimes?
sentences.zh: 例如，你们是否发现总统指示白宫法律顾问致电代理司法部长，告诉他必须撤换特别检察官？

sentences.en: Did you find substantial evidence that the president had committed obstruction of justice crimes?
sentences.zh: 听起来这些问题的答案要么是“是”，要么是“否”，这似乎就是目的，仅仅是为了得到简单的“是”或“否”的回答。

sentences.en: For example, did you find that the president directed the White House counsel to call the acting attorney general and tell him the special counsel must be removed?
sentences.zh: 没错，但是当然，虽然简单，却可能具有爆炸性。

sentences.en: It sounds like these are questions whose answers would be either yes or no, and that seems to be the goal, just to get simple yes or no answers.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Correct, but sure, simple, but potentially explosive.
sentences.zh: 你认为总统触犯法律了吗？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 对这个问题回答“是”将是一个游戏规则的改变者。

sentences.en: Did you believe the president broke the law?
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: A yes to that question is a game changer.
sentences.zh: 但如果穆勒死守这些指示，我们就不会听到这些答案。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 他对这些问题不会给出“是”或“否”的回答。

sentences.en: But if Mueller sticks to the instructions, we're not going to hear those answers.
sentences.zh: 这些指示将阻止他这样做。

sentences.en: He will not offer yes or no answers to those questions.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来推演一下。

sentences.en: The instructions would stop him from doing that.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Well, let's play this out.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果穆勒遵循指示，而他们问他，你们是否就总统是否犯有妨碍司法公正罪做出了判断，

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 根据报告，穆勒对此的回答是，他们没有对总统做出传统的检方决定。

sentences.en: So if Mueller's following the instructions and they ask him, did you reach a judgment as to whether the president had committed obstruction of justice crimes,
sentences.zh: 他们只是收集了证据，并研究了围绕该问题的法律问题，因为他们认为指控总统违法是不公平的，

sentences.en: Mueller's answer to that, based on the report, is that they did not make a traditional prosecutorial decision about the president.
sentences.zh: 因为总统将没有机会还自己清白。

sentences.en: They simply collected evidence and looked at the questions of law around that because they didn't think it was fair to accuse the president of breaking the law
sentences.zh: 我是说，我在开玩笑，但在你回答期间，我基本上已经打瞌睡了，你的意思是，穆勒将对这些问题给出一个检察官式的、复杂的、

sentences.en: because he wouldn't have a chance to clear his name.
sentences.zh: 非通俗易懂的回答，因此，你想要得到一个爆炸性的“是”或一个令人满意的“否”的想法是不太可能的。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm being facetious, but during your answer, I basically nodded off, is what you're saying, that Mueller is going to offer a prosecutorial, complicated,
sentences.zh: 不，但这正是过去四个月里一直存在的问题。

sentences.en: non-colloquial answer to these questions, and therefore the idea that you're going to get an explosive yes or a satisfying no is unlikely.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚讨论的关于为什么穆勒没有指控总统触犯法律的问题，是一个非常难懂的问题，它正是这份报告的核心所在。

sentences.en: No, but that has been the issue over the past four months.
sentences.zh: 我可以理解为什么许多美国人很难理解这一点或者听得直打瞌睡。

sentences.en: The issue we just discussed about why is it that Mueller didn't accuse the president of breaking the law is a very difficult one to understand, and it's at the heart of the report.
sentences.zh: 这是否表明民主党人采纳科米的这份问题清单是一个潜在的有缺陷的方法？

sentences.en: And I can see why many Americans struggled to get their heads around that or nodded off.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不太确定，因为民主党人的目标基本上是让穆勒说点什么，当然，至少要重述报告中的内容。

sentences.en: Does that suggest that this is a potentially flawed approach for Democrats to take the Comey list of questions?
sentences.zh: 所以，是非题对他们来说可能很难，因为“是”或“否”的回答可能并不能阐明多少问题。

sentences.en: Well, I'm not sure because the goal by the Democrats is basically to get Mueller to say something and certainly to, at the very least, recite what's in the report.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，穆勒在不违反规定的情况下，是无法用“是”或“否”来回答这些问题的。

sentences.en: So, yes or no questions could be difficult for them because a yes or no answer may not illuminate things that much.
sentences.zh: 好吧，还有尼尔·凯蒂尔的问题，你曾为《每日新闻》采访过他，

sentences.en: But at the same time, Mueller can't answer these questions yes or no without violating the rules.
sentences.zh: 我也为《每日新闻》采访过他，他起草了规范特别检察官调查如何进行的规则。

sentences.en: Okay, then there are the questions from Neil Katyal, who you've interviewed for The Daily,
sentences.zh: 你能读一下尼尔的一些问题吗？

sentences.en: I've interviewed for The Daily, and who wrote the rules that govern how the special counsel investigation was carried out.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，凯蒂尔的问题触及的是特朗普总统用来为自己辩护的言辞。

sentences.en: Can you read a few of Neil's questions?
sentences.zh: 没有通俄，没有妨碍司法，我已经完全彻底地被清白了。

sentences.en: It feels to me like what Katyal's questions are getting at are the words that President Trump uses in defense of himself.
sentences.zh: 据我阅读，凯蒂尔的问题是试图让穆勒与总统产生一点公开的争执，

sentences.en: No collusion, no obstruction, I've been completely and totally exonerated.
sentences.zh: 站在这些问题的对立面，并指出总统对这些事情的定性是错误的，虽然不一定直接这么说。

sentences.en: And from my reading, Katyal's questions are an attempt to get Mueller to be in a bit of a public spat with the president,
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: to be on the other side of those questions and to say the way he's characterizing those are wrong, without necessarily saying it that way.
sentences.zh: 调查结束后，总统的口径一直是：没有通俄，没有妨碍司法，我被彻底洗白了。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 如果你让穆勒——一个受信任的人——说出与总统直接相矛盾的话，这能扭转乾坤吗？

sentences.en: The president's talking points in the aftermath of the investigation have been, no collusion, no obstruction, I was totally exonerated.
sentences.zh: 所以这个策略，迈克，比科米的要稍微更有野心一些。

sentences.en: And if you have Mueller, someone who is trusted, saying things that directly contradict the president, could that move the needle?
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是重申报告中的内容，而是要听到罗伯特·穆勒说特朗普谈论调查的方式是错误的。

sentences.en: So this strategy, Mike, is slightly more ambitious than Comey's.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到民主党策略师正在试图制作这样一则广告：里面有特朗普说“没有通俄”的片段，而穆勒则说“我对此没有做定性”。

sentences.en: Not just reiterate what's in the report, but to hear Robert Mueller say that the way Trump talks about his investigation is wrong.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到特朗普说“我被彻底洗白了”的片段，而穆勒说“我没有洗白总统”，

sentences.en: You can see the Democratic strategist trying to come up with the ad where there's a clip of Trump saying no collusion and Mueller saying I didn't make a determination on that.
sentences.zh: 让这两人针锋相对，以证明总统一直在就这份报告误导公众。

sentences.en: You can see the clip of Trump saying I was totally exonerated and Mueller saying I did not exonerate the president,
sentences.zh: 这就是这集的全部内容。

sentences.en: using the two of them to face off against each other to show that the president has been misleading about the report.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: And what about you, Mike?
sentences.zh: 迈克，你呢？

sentences.en: What question would you be most interested to hear the Democrats asking Mueller?
sentences.zh: 你最希望听到民主党人向穆勒提出什么问题？

sentences.en: I mean, this all comes down to did they think the president broke the law?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这一切归根结底都在于他们是否认为总统触犯了法律。

sentences.en: And to know whether Mueller thought the president broke the law would certainly provide some clarity to this situation.
sentences.zh: 而且，了解穆勒是否认为总统触犯了法律，肯定能为这种局面带来一些清晰的认识。

sentences.en: I think I'd want to hear the Democrats ask for a more detailed explanation for why they chose to not accuse the president of breaking the law.
sentences.zh: 我想听听民主党人要求对他们为什么选择不指控总统违法做出更详细的解释。

sentences.en: To try and allow Mueller to illuminate on that, expand on it, and help us understand it better.
sentences.zh: 试着让穆勒对此作进一步阐述、展开说明，并帮助我们更好地理解它。

sentences.en: And you'd like to hear Mueller answer it.
sentences.zh: 而你希望听到穆勒对此进行回答。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯DealBook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市DealBook峰会的现场，采访商业、政治和文化领域一些最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话，就在它们发生的时候。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于NYTimes.com上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并获得一个月的免费权限来阅读我们所有的深度报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收听。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: So, Mike, you just outlined what success might look like for the Democrats in their hearings with Robert Mueller.
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，你刚刚概述了民主党人在与罗伯特·穆勒的听证会上可能取得的成功是什么样的。

sentences.en: What about Republicans?
sentences.zh: 共和党人呢？

sentences.en: What does success look like for them?
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，成功是什么样的？

sentences.en: To maintain the status quo.
sentences.zh: 维持现状。

sentences.en: And I wonder what that looks like in a hearing where they have almost equal time to Democrats in asking questions.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在这样一个听证会上，他们提问的时间与民主党人几乎相等，那会是什么样子。

sentences.en: I think that there are sort of two strains on the Republican side.
sentences.zh: 我认为共和党阵营里大致有两种诉求。

sentences.en: One is the strain of the Tea Party folks who have been itching to question Mueller for the past two years.
sentences.zh: 一种是茶党成员的诉求，他们在过去两年里一直渴望质问穆勒。

sentences.en: They are going to ask questions about the text messages by Strzok and Page.
sentences.zh: 他们会询问关于斯特佐克和佩奇发出的短信的问题。

sentences.en: The former FBI agents who the president says showed a bias against him.
sentences.zh: 这两位前联邦调查局特工被总统指控对有他偏见。

sentences.en: Why did you hire so many Democrats?
sentences.zh: 你为什么雇了那么多民主党人？

sentences.en: Why did you hire so many people who had given money to Hillary Clinton?
sentences.zh: 你为什么雇了那么多给希拉里·克林顿捐过款的人？

sentences.en: Were you favorable to Comey because we think he's your best friend?
sentences.zh: 你对科米比较关照吗，因为我们觉得他是你最好的朋友？

sentences.en: And this is their chance to finally face off with Mueller.
sentences.zh: 这是他们最后一次有机会与穆勒正面交锋。

sentences.en: And I find it hard to believe that they're not going to take a shot at just having the clip of them asking those questions.
sentences.zh: 我很难相信他们不会抓住机会，弄出一段他们质问这些问题的视频剪辑。

sentences.en: So direct all their attention to possible bias in the investigation, not the findings of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 因此，把他们所有的注意力都引向调查中可能存在的偏见，而不是调查的结果。

sentences.en: And so in a sense, not just maintain status quo, but deepen skepticism of Mueller and his investigation among their constituents.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这不仅是维持现状，还要在他们的选民中加深对穆勒及其调查的怀疑。

sentences.en: I just think it's going to be very hard for them to avoid that, especially when they've beat that drum so hard.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得他们很难避开这一点，尤其是当他们把这个调子敲得这么响的时候。

sentences.en: The other strain that the Republicans are going to want to hit on is the overarching conclusion of the report,
sentences.zh: 共和党人想要切入的另一个诉求是报告的总体结论，

sentences.en: which was that there was no criminal conspiracy between the campaign and Russia.
sentences.zh: 即竞选团队和俄罗斯之间没有刑事共谋。

sentences.en: And to get Mueller to say that, because this is the question that's hung over Trump since he won.
sentences.zh: 并让穆勒说出这一点，因为这个问题自特朗普获胜以来一直悬而未决。

sentences.en: And the Republicans in the document have Mueller saying that there was no criminal conspiracy between the campaign and Russia.
sentences.zh: 共和党人在文件里引用了穆勒的话，证明竞选团队和俄罗斯之间没有刑事共谋。

sentences.en: So why not get the person who led the investigation to say that this person who they have accused of being on a witch hunt has cleared the president and his campaign on the biggest question of the 2016 election?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么不让领导调查的人说出这句话呢？这样，他们一直指控是在搞政治迫害的人，就在2016年大选最大的问题上为总统和他的竞选团队洗清了嫌疑。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's like the reverse Democratic strategy.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是民主党策略的反向操作。

sentences.en: Get the most powerful voice possible to animate the report in ways that benefit the president.
sentences.zh: 利用最具影响力的声音，以对总统有利的方式来生动呈现这份报告。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what about Robert Mueller himself?
sentences.zh: 那么罗伯特·穆勒本人呢？

sentences.en: What would success look like to him in these hearings?
sentences.zh: 对他来说，在这些听证会上取得成功是什么样的？

sentences.en: I think that if the instructions are to not go beyond the report, to walk out of there simply reciting what is in the document.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果给他的指示是不要超出报告范围，仅仅在离开时背诵文件中的内容就行。

sentences.en: I don't think he wants to be drawn into discussing the internal deliberations of his office.
sentences.zh: 我想他不想被卷入讨论他办公室内部审议过程的事情中。

sentences.en: And I think if he walks out of there having just simply gone over what he's already put out there for him, that'll be a win.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果他离开时只是简单地重温了他已经公开发布的内容，那就是一次胜利。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: His goal is kind of to be boring.
sentences.zh: 他的目标就是表现得无趣。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's certainly done a decent job at that for the past two years.
sentences.zh: 是的，在过去的两年里，他在这方面确实做得不错。

sentences.en: So this hearing could be quite boring.
sentences.zh: 所以这场听证会可能会相当无趣。

sentences.en: And if it is, that will have been by Mueller's design.
sentences.zh: 如果真是这样，那也是穆勒刻意安排的结果。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If that's what happens,
sentences.zh: 如果事情真的如此，

sentences.en: is this kind of officially the final death blow for the Democrats when it comes to any meaningful consequences for the Mueller report on the Trump presidency?
sentences.zh: 这是否算得上是民主党人在穆勒报告对特朗普总统任期的实质性影响方面，正式宣告彻底破产？

sentences.en: Well, if Mueller doesn't move the needle,
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果穆勒没有掀起什么波澜，

sentences.en: then I think it's going to take a fairly significant disclosure about something else that we don't know about to really galvanize the Democrats to do something.
sentences.zh: 那么我认为需要有关于其他我们目前不知道的事情的相当重大的披露，才能真正激励民主党人采取行动。

sentences.en: I think that if Mueller sticks to the report and is not providing juicy soundbites for the Democrats, then this will sort of be where it is now.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果穆勒死守报告，不给民主党人提供劲爆的言论素材，那么情况就会维持现状。

sentences.en: And the Democrats will put their hopes on the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 民主党人将把他们的希望寄托在2020年的大曲上。

sentences.en: Because impeachment is basically dead.
sentences.zh: 因为弹劾基本已经没戏了。

sentences.en: It'll be a hill too steep to climb.
sentences.zh: 这将是一座难以逾越的高山。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you.
sentences.zh: 迈克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: We will talk to you once these hearings are over tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天听证会结束后，我们再和你聊。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我参加。

sentences.en: That's it for now.
sentences.zh: 今天就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》将为我们做好假期接待客人的准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的妙招。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一沾枕头就睡着的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会因断片而睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用上或在你喜欢收听播客的地方寻找《Wirecutter秀》。
